register.source_checks:
The issue says this repository's packing-witness verify, run unmodified on the witness at main 200f2ebc, reports VERIFIED (exact-algebraic, 19701 pairs), and that verifier/sqcheck.py, an exact checker the author's lab wrote separately from this repository's code, reports VALID (exact rational) and prints the exact side rounded up. It says the two share only the unit-square, wall and non-overlap definitions.

Squares 1 to 172 are #935's witness with its rational corners unchanged, whose exact coordinates this repository's packing-witness promote --strategy robust-rational made from the lab's decimal pose, so packing-witness verify is not independent of how they were rounded, as the issue says. The 27 grid squares touch each other, the walls and the n = 172 packing's bounding square exactly, so the exact minimum pair gap is 0, as in the record's grid witnesses; sqcheck.py certified the decimal pose in interval arithmetic only with a dilation of 1e-24. No local-optimality, rigidity or formal check is claimed. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit:
Credit Doğa Özden (https://dogaozden.com/math/live/square-packing/), who reports his n = 172 packing of issue 935 (T-282), found from the registry's 172, Evan Daniel's packing (T-257, #845), by basin hopping over local minima of Evan Daniel's ALM+SLP quench (https://github.com/evand/square-packing, MIT), with an L of 27 unit squares added along two walls: the classical L step, s(n + 2 floor(s) + 1) <= s(n) + 1 (Friedman's DS7, section 2). Nothing was searched at 199. The issue asks that the improvement be credited to Özden, the base packing to its holders as the record lists them, and the local optimizer to Evan Daniel.

The issue says the search and its code were written and run by AI agents and that the checks were run by code that did not produce the packing; the issue and repository were prepared and posted by Özden's AI agent, which uses the account kenaznia-doga, and Özden directed the work. The best published Kaggle per-puzzle side the issue found at 199, 14.617572173606 (kirilltym), is above this and states no packing; the author's comment of 20:53:05Z adds a side-only leaderboard entry, 14.6132098756 (team OigaZhDn, 31 October), below this side, which states no packing and so is no report.
